reviews.text: Moreno treats the dogs he grooms as if they were his own. His prices are also fair.

Moreno is the best in his field. For many years, he has cared for my little wolf very well, with love and professionalism. I highly recommend Moreno not only for the quality of his work, but also for his human and ethical qualities. Over the years, he has proven himself to be a wonderful person: to work with our four-legged friends, you need a warm heart. Thank you.
Good morning, thank you very much for your availability :)

Wonderful experience with Mia!!
Guided by the wonderful reviews, I entrusted Moreno with grooming little Mia, a recently adopted ragdoll cat whose fur had never been brushed, and was full of hideous, untouchable knots.
Moreno was wonderful; the cat let himself be brushed with ease, every knot was treated with skill, gentleness, and tenderness, all accompanied by cuddles, kisses (much appreciated by little Mia, who loves being cuddled), and words that calmed her.
Thank you, thank you, thank you!!

Both my mom and I have two Siberians who don't like being combed and therefore get tangled very often.
Thanks to a friend who already went there, I met Moreno, and we've been regulars for almost two years now.
Moreno, or rather, Uncle Moreno for the dwarfs, is fantastic with them. He's loving, cuddles them and treats them like they were his own, and knows how to keep them calm even when they get nervous. I couldn't ask for anything better for them!
I brought Sasha, a Lagotto Romagnolo, and she did an exceptional job! Thank you and congratulations for your professionalism.
